descriptor_policy: Use complete WHIMand3D-MoRSEvectors from their common default explicit-H ETKDGv3seed42unoptimized conformer policy. This controlled software-distance audit uses the raw reported descriptor scales;it does not claim statistically calibrated cross-family units.
distance_models: For each family compute mean squared component difference MSE_f. The intended equal-family distance is sqrt((MSE_WHIM+MSE_MORSE)/2). A legacy export instead concatenates the vectors and takes one overall component RMS. Report vector lengths,the two family MSEs,and both distances.
scope: No undefined components may be zero-filled and no partial vector may be substituted. Family weighting is explicit model choice,not evidence of physical molecular distance.
